heroHeadline: ENDF Chief Pledges 'Restraint' While Accusing Egypt, Sudan and Eritrea of Backing Rebel Alliance
heroSubtitle: Multi-front fighting continues across Tigray, Afar and Amhara after the EPFAS coalition seized three airports and ENDF claimed 272 fighters killed in a North Wollo counteroffensive; Army Chief Birhanu Jula now accuses foreign powers of arming the alliance.
footerNote: Data sourced from official reports, major outlets, and institutional analyses.
